import hashlib

import re

from subject import _extract_frames, compute_error_fingerprint


def test_extract_frames_basic():
    traceback = '''Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "pkg_a/foo.py", line 10, in bar
    x = 1
  File "pkg_b/baz.py", line 20, in qux
    y = 2
'''
    frames = _extract_frames(traceback)
    assert frames == ["pkg_a/foo.py:bar", "pkg_b/baz.py:qux"]

def test_compute_error_fingerprint_known_value():
    failure_output = '''Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "pkg_a/foo.py", line 10, in bar
    x = 1
'''
    failing_tests = ["test_a", "test_b"]
    frames = _extract_frames(failure_output)
    sorted_tests = sorted(failing_tests)
    payload = json.dumps({"frames": frames, "tests": sorted_tests}, sort_keys=True)
    expected = hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest()
    actual = compute_error_fingerprint(failure_output, failing_tests)
    assert actual == expected
